sloka: इदं च धनुरुद्यम्य सज्यं य: कुरुते नर: ।तस्य मे दुहिता भार्या भविष्यति न संशय: ॥ २.११८.४२॥
transliteration: idaṁ ca dhanurudyamya sajyaṁ ya: kurute nara: ।tasya me duhitā bhāryā bhaviṣyati na saṁśaya: ॥ 2.118.42॥

translations.english: Whatever man lifts this bow and strings it, to him my daughter shall become his wife—of this there is no doubt.
